note: Goal: a daily report-only `procs` step in scripts/dev/c_drive_guard.py lists python/pythonw/node/pwsh/powershell/cmd/bash/conhost processes older than 24 h whose command line matches a safe pattern (desk.py, sim_desk, layers.fabio, repo script paths). `procs --apply` kills only by PID. Never a process with a claude.exe ancestor; never anything touching .mts_live, live_runner, loop-supervisor, start-trading-day, oi_recorder, orderflow_live, htf_context_live, sync.py ship, deploy; never java; no kill by image name. Safe patterns go in the allow list of MyTradingSys/system/STRAY_REAP_POLICY.md (operator edit needed). Done when: the report lists the JIS-NB leftovers (pythonw x2 146 h, desk.py --port 8790 x2, cmd) and tests fail on old code and cover the never-kill rules; no new scheduled task (SCHEDULING_POLICY.md). Related, not a twin: c-drive-cleanup-holds (worktrees and temp).
title: Stray process report in c_drive_guard
